NFL DFS Projections Week 5: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 11 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 9, 1:17 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 5 DraftKings main slate: 26.6 DraftKings points at $9,800. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations. Chase Brown holds the largest share at 44% for $6,900.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Chase Brown (26.5, $6,900), Jaylen Warren (25.4, $6,700), Drake Maye (20.7, $6,300) and Jared Goff (20.5, $6,600). Chase Brown returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.84 projected points per $1,000. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the wide receivers at 19.8 for $8,800, Drake Maye leads the quarterbacks at 20.7 for $6,300, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 20.3 for $6,700.

The 11-game slate runs from a 54.5-point total in DET at ARI down to 37.5 in HOU at TEN. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 9, 1:17 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 5 DraftKings projections

Drake Maye, NE vs LV ($6,300)

Drake Maye carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.7 DraftKings points at $6,300, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.2 points clear of Jared Goff. The model includes 5.0 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.28 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Maye averaged 20.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 37.8, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Jared Goff, DET at ARI ($6,600)

Jared Goff projects 2nd at the position with 20.5 DraftKings points at $6,600, 5th on the main slate overall. The salary works out to 3.11 projected points per $1,000, 11th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 37.4, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Tyson Bagent, CHI at GB ($4,700)

Tyson Bagent projects for 17.7 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.77 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 5.5 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Bagent averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 32.3, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Chicago is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.
